_comment: Nuru main configuration. Edit seats after calibration (python -m nuru calibrate).
_seats_comment: Seat positions in metres relative to the robot: [x, y, z]. x = left/right, y = up/down (0 = robot eye height), z = distance in front. Listed left-to-right as seen by the operator standing behind the robot.

moderation._auto_comment: Auto-invite rules (when auto_invite is on): (a) a lull of auto_invite_silence_s, or (b) a turn boundary (turn_end_gap_s of silence) once turn_end_invite_interval_s have passed since the last invitation. Rule (b) is what gives the robot enough opportunities to act; set it to 0 to disable.
